'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Barry Alperstein LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name blank; starts at '''Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' with [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
